question: Can each target supply the maximum-baseline fully visible second reference available in the recorded trajectory before RGB/model access?

predecessor.single_change: Replace the unavailable uniform 0.30-0.60m band with maximum fully visible displacement in a frozen 0.05-1.10m reachability interval. Keep target completeness, depth visibility, margin, ranking dimensions and RGB/model blindness unchanged.

selection.ranking: Maximum available fully visible baseline up to 1.10m, then minimum frame gap, then maximum depth-visible ratio, visible vertices and projected area, then earliest frame.

forbidden_after_freeze: open candidate RGB or call a model before all three active frames are fixed
change reachability, completeness or ranking after viewing selected RGB
replace an active frame after downstream failure
claim provider-selected reference views establish raw-camera binding or user-action feasibility
claim_boundary: This freeze selects the maximum available fully visible second reference in each recorded trajectory using provider geometry and depth before RGB/model access. Baselines may differ across targets and do not prove a user can execute the action. It is Development input selection, not raw-camera binding, provider-independent generalization, navigation, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety evidence.
